picks.headline: One UI 9 brings agentic Gemini Intelligence to Galaxy
picks.excerpt: One UI 9 debuts Gemini Intelligence on Galaxy devices, adding agentic automation that acts across apps, plus AI features like text-prompt widget creation, smarter autofill and voice-to-text Rambler.
picks.rationale: Most actionable pick: agentic cross-app automation and text-prompt widget creation change how Galaxy users actually work; a shipping OS feature set, not a rumor.

picks.headline: Samsung Galaxy Glasses specs leak: Snapdragon AR1, dual cameras, deep Gemini
picks.excerpt: Leaked specs for Samsung's Android XR Galaxy Glasses point to a Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 chip, dual cameras and deep Gemini integration for hands-free AI capture, translation and navigation ahead of Unpacked.
picks.rationale: Freshest hardware scoop (07-21) and a distinct product from any published Samsung item; concrete Android XR specs signal where hands-free AI wearables land next.

picks.headline: Snapdragon X2 Elite AI PCs benchmarked against latest Intel and AMD laptops
picks.excerpt: After testing several Snapdragon X2 Elite systems, Notebookcheck compares the 80-TOPS Hexagon NPU AI PCs against the latest Intel and AMD laptops on performance and efficiency.
picks.rationale: Hands-on multi-system benchmark of 80-TOPS NPUs gives designers real efficiency/performance data for choosing an on-device AI laptop; distinct topic from wearables.

picks.headline: Surface Laptop 13.8 review: Snapdragon X2 Plus clears the Copilot+ AI bar
picks.excerpt: Review of Microsoft's Surface Laptop 13.8 (2026) built on the Snapdragon X2 Plus, a Copilot+ AI PC with a much faster CPU and an NPU that clears Microsoft's on-device AI requirements.
picks.rationale: Concrete shipping-device review (distinct product and article from the X2 Elite comparison) showing a mainstream Copilot+ machine meeting on-device AI requirements.
